data.headline: NVIDIA results add to November’s S&P 500 positioning backdrop
data.summary: NVIDIA’s November 17 filing reported revenue growth of 103% year over year. In the November 10 E-mini S&P 500 futures report, leveraged funds reduced their net short and asset managers reduced their net long.

bull.text: Leveraged funds’ November 10 net short was 303,060 contracts, down 69,258 from November 3.

bear.text: The asset-manager net long fell to 914,130 contracts even as contract open interest rose to 2,017,687.

watch.text: NVIDIA reported $115.8 billion in quarterly revenue. Watch how widely the earnings reaction spreads across large-cap stocks.

limitations: The CFTC figures describe a related futures contract on November 10. The filing covers NVIDIA only.
Matched earnings expectations, post-release SPY prices and a full option-chain reading remain unavailable.
